July 8, 1971
Mr. Franklin Richard, Superintendent School District 170 16th Street and Aberdeen Street Chicago, Heights, Illinois 60411
Dear Mr. Richard:
In order to continue our study and to determine the impact of the subject project, on "Fecheation and Parks", it is necessary to get some first hand information from those directly affected.
We have, therefore, attached to this letter a drawing which shows the area which the Illinois Division of Highways would acquire if the present Lincoln Highway widening plan is approved. It should be mentioned that this approval can only take place after a public hearing is held and after the testimony resulting from the public hearing process is reviewed and analyzed. A date of late summer or early fall is our best estimate for this hearing.
With the above in mind, please furnish to this office the following information relative to the sites affected by the proposed highway project.
   A description of the total site which would include the site location, features, usage, ownership (any reversionary clauses or property-deed restrictions should be identified), etc.
2. A description of the proposed portion of the site to be acquired (similar to Item No. 1 above).
